title: Light Painting Four Forest Harvesting Rigs
description: A really pretty light painted photograph of forestry harvesting equipment at sunrise in Danbury, Wisconsin. From left to right we have a SERCO 300 Series Loader with a 72″ SERCO Saw, a John Deere 2154G Swing Machine with a Pro Pac Delimber, and a second SERCO 300 Series Loader with a 72″ SERCO Saw. And, on the far right, a John Deere 948L-II Grapple Skidder.

title: Light Painting "Beauty and the Beasts"
description: A cool light painted photo of a 2023 Kenworth T880, a 2024 Mack P164T, and a 2006 Corvette Z06 in front of Fornengo Forest Products Headquarters in Danbury, WI. We took 367 images that night and the resulting light painting is really cool!

title: Light Painting Two Forest Harvesting Rigs
description: A pretty light painted photograph of a John Deere 1210 Forwarder and a Tigercat H822E Skidder with a Waratah HTH623C Harvester Head. This unique image was created near Danbury, Wisconsin.

title: Light Painting for Fornengo Forest Products
description: A beautiful light painted photograph of six forestry harvesting machines with accessories. This unique image was created for Fornengo Forest Products located in Danbury, Wisconsin. Featured in this cool image are a John Deere 2154G Swing Machine, a John Deere 948L-II Grapple Skidder, a Pro Pac Delimber, two SERCO 300 Series Loaders, both with 72" SERCO Saws, a Tigercat 5400 Felling Saw, a Tigercat 625E Skidder, and a Tigercat X830E Feller Buncher.

title: Light Painting 5 Construction Vehicles
